name: AI RAG Search
description: Integrates ChatGPT (OpenAI) with Search API to return contextual, retrieval-augmented answers alongside search results.
project_description: AI RAG Search (machine name: airagsearch) integrates Drupal's Search API with OpenAI's chat models (ChatGPT) to add a retrieval-augmented question-answering layer on top of keyword search. On a search page at /airagsearch, it runs the query against a configured Search API index, feeds the top-ranked result bodies to the OpenAI Chat Completions API as context, and returns a concise AI-written answer grounded in that content, together with the traditional result list. A separate summary view at /airagsearch/summary composes an overview across up to 20 results. An analytics dashboard at /admin/reports/airagsearch-analytics tracks query frequency and zero-result rates with automatic pruning. The module provides a settings form (API key, index selection, model choice, temperature, token limits, context sizing), a Test Connection form, a block plugin, and a set of JSON REST endpoints under /api/airagsearch gated by a dedicated permission. It depends on the Search API module and works with any Search API backend (database, Solr, Elasticsearch). Requires Drupal 10 or 11 and PHP 8.1+.
